# HitItOff — Full site reference for AI indexing

## Product summary

HitItOff is a compatibility-first dating application for iOS and Android. The app combines a personality quiz, compatibility scoring, and location-based discovery to help users find better local matches. Tagline: "Better Matches, Closer."

## Core features (free)

- Personality quiz matching
- Swipe to discover nearby singles
- Up to 20 likes per day
- 3 messages per match on free plan
- Search radius up to 3 miles
- Basic discovery filters
- Mutual like required to match and chat

## HitItOff Pro features

- Unlimited likes per day
- Unlimited messages
- Search up to 50 mi radius
- Advanced dating preferences
- See who liked you
- View all profile photos
- Compatibility scores on every profile
- Send and receive super likes
- 20-second video intro
- Profile boosts
- Age, compatibility, and interest filters
- Video and Instagram profile filters
- No ads

## How matching works

1. Users complete a compatibility quiz covering personality, lifestyle, values, humor, and relationship preferences.
2. HitItOff calculates compatibility using quiz similarity combined with distance within the selected search radius.
3. Users swipe on profiles in their discovery feed.
4. When both users like each other, they match and can chat.

## FAQ

Q: What is HitItOff?
A: HitItOff is a compatibility-first dating app that helps you meet singles nearby using a personality quiz, compatibility scores, and local discovery.

Q: Is HitItOff free?
A: Yes. A free plan is available. HitItOff Pro adds unlimited likes and messages, larger radius, advanced filters, video intros, boosts, and an ad-free experience.

Q: What age is required?
A: Users must be 18 or older.

Q: Does HitItOff use location?
A: Yes, with permission, to show nearby profiles and calculate distance-based compatibility.

Q: Is the app available now?
A: HitItOff is launching soon on iOS and Android. Join the waitlist at https://hititoff.vercel.app/#waitlist
